title: Find the longest word in a file
statement: Read a nonempty sequence of lowercase words from words.txt. Its first value is n, followed by n words. Create longest.txt containing the first word of maximum length and that length.
input_format: The text file words.txt contains n (1 <= n <= 1000), followed by n lowercase ASCII words of 1 to 100 characters. Standard input is not used.
output_format: Create longest.txt and write the first longest word and its length, separated by a space. Standard output is not used.
